compatibility_changes: Installed the complete offline PRiMeFlow/PerturBench dependency closure without replacing the container Torch runtime.
Used PerturBench's torch-backed cosine annealing warm-restarts scheduler because the upstream linear-warmup scheduler imports an obsolete pl_bolts Lightning API.
Disabled the unavailable ESM2 parquet input so the model used its supported learned gene embedding path.
Used a deterministic train-derived validation split because PerturBench removes unseen official-validation perturbations and leaves that split empty.
limitations: This is a bounded execution smoke, not full H1 training or paper reproduction.
The validation cells are held out from the selected official-training cells, not the official VCC25 validation perturbations.
The observed losses are smoke diagnostics and are not official VCC25 metrics.
No checkpoint or inference artifact was retained by this smoke.
No official validation or final-test expression matrix was read.
